supporting_scope: The third section of the SCiO portfolio mixes systemic intervention practices with generic professional techniques. The ten additional pages provide basic rehearsals for the explicitly systemic and closely related inquiry, learning, conversation, service and evaluation work named in their headings. They are not a claim to teach every professional technique in that section.
outside_scope: Generic presentation, public-speaking, selling, training-design and coaching qualifications are not supplied by this pack.
NLP, transactional analysis and other separately trained practices are not relabelled as systems methods or certified here.
Advanced statistics, full Six Sigma, specialist sector law, safeguarding and regulatory compliance need their own study and contextual assessment.
Real facilitation, collaboration, implementation, resilience and professional conduct cannot be established by a solo practice page.

The Systems Laws and Transposing Theory rows receive explicit introductory exercises, not a claim of exhaustive theoretical coverage. INFORMED, Interactive Management and Syntegration pages state which part of their fuller process is rehearsed.
crosswalk_status: Editorial mapping for practice, not SCiO endorsement, accreditation or an end-point assessment judgement. The portfolio distinguishes training/case-study application from work in organisations. These fictional exercises remain in that learning category.
